name: Cosmic Brownie Cookies
desc: Thick, crackly-topped brownie cookies spread with chocolate ganache and rainbow candy chips.

source.title: Better Than CRUMBL Cosmic Brownie Cookies
source.evidence: Identical ingredient list and amounts (1 cup + 2 tbsp flour, 8 oz melted chips, 2/3 cup brown sugar, 6 oz ganache chips with 1/4 cup cream) and the same 10-cookie, 12 minute bake.

ingredients.raw: 8 oz good-quality semisweet chocolate chips (about 1 1/3 cups)
6 oz good-quality semisweet chocolate chips (1 cup)
1/4 cup rainbow candy-coated chocolate chips, for topping

steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper or a silicone mat.
In a small bowl, whisk the flour, cocoa, baking powder and salt. Set aside.
Melt the butter and chocolate chips in a medium saucepan over medium-low heat, stirring constantly until smooth. Set aside to cool slightly.
Beat the eggs, vanilla, brown sugar and granulated sugar with a stand or hand mixer on medium-high for 3-5 minutes, until pale, airy and doubled in volume.
Gently fold the chocolate mixture into the egg mixture with a rubber spatula. Fold in the dry ingredients only until the flour disappears.
Scoop the batter into 10 equal mounds with a large cookie scoop, 2 inches apart. Bake 12 minutes, until the tops are shiny and crackled and the edges are set.

Right out of the oven, set a round cookie cutter wider than each cookie over it and swirl it around the edge to shape a neat, thick round. Cool on the sheet 10 minutes, then move to a rack to cool completely.
Ganache: microwave the chocolate chips and cream in 30-second bursts, stirring between each, until smooth. Let it thicken 5 minutes.
Spoon 2-3 tsp ganache onto each cookie, spread it, and sprinkle with rainbow chips. Let the ganache set about 30 minutes before stacking.
